name: Gratien
source:
A young man and former slave who takes up residence in the slums after the revolt at the lord’s estate.

Gratien, whose ancestors are rumored to have been gladiators, is a rowdy man with unparalleled physical strength, which is what has allowed him to survive so long.

Like Jacopo, he despises the lord and his tyrannical rule. Over time, the two of them build up a trust for one another, eventually leading to talks of revolution.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1053/]MangaGamer[/url]]
